steps.title: Engine configuration
steps.note: createWorkflowEngine accepts config for concurrency limits, default timeout, history, and lifecycle hooks.

steps.title: Built-in routing node
steps.note: condition:if evaluates a JavaScript boolean expression against the input data and context, then emits either the true or false output port.

steps.title: Execute a workflow
steps.note: execute() looks up the workflow, enforces the concurrency limit, builds the DAG, initializes execution state, and kicks off starting nodes.

steps.title: Dependency-aware node execution
steps.note: executeNode() checks every incoming connection and returns early until all dependency nodes have completed results.

steps.title: Engine public surface
steps.note: The returned engine object exposes registerWorkflow, execute, cancelExecution, pauseExecution, resumeExecution, and node-type registration.
